name: r2-package-verify
purpose: Assemble exact candidate pure sources around unchanged audited native leaves and verify in an isolated installed consumer
reuse: Retained Windows native wheel and original source/provenance maps; existing interpreter and offline hash-locked dependency cache
consumer: One disposable locked environment is necessary for the new artifact. Do not modify identity-pinned consumers or the canonical editable installation
source: Materialize only declared package inputs, notices and selected test/helper sources from the exact candidate commit. No dependency source tree, SDK, build history or previous evidence copy
constraints: No renderer/SDK compilation, network dependency fallback, system installation, verifier relaxation, publication or transfer of historical approvals. Native production inputs and original archive joins must match
terminal_cleanup: Await children; retain commands, source/artifact identities, licenses, audit/results and failure reproducer. Apply managed cleanup using the existing protected/blocked registry
scope: Artifact assembly and local development verification only; final-head CI, collector/preparation renewal and mandatory release qualification remain separate
